summary_md: **Teddy ([@teddyaisi](https://x.com/teddyaisi/status/2115025698922660003))** notes that Anthropic donated **Agent Skills** to the Agentic AI Foundation on Oct 22 — the name, GitHub org and agentskills.io went with it — and that maintainers from Anthropic, Google and OpenAI now run the spec as individuals, with 70+ platforms loading SKILL.md folders. Teddy advises pinning the spec version skills target.
relevance: Governance change for the SKILL.md standard that harness builders depend on.
